name: computer-use-linux
description: See and control a Linux desktop (Hyprland on Wayland) through the computer-use-linux MCP server: screenshots, pointer, keyboard, scrolling, clipboard and AT-SPI accessibility.

image_profile.title: Screenshot image profile
image_profile.description: Screenshot size limits matched to the model, so its coordinates are screenshot pixels: high-resolution for Claude 4.7 and later, standard for older Claude models, full for up to 3200 px.

accessibility_detail.title: Accessibility tree detail
accessibility_detail.description: compact keeps observations within Claude Code's tool-output limits; full returns every node and field; none omits the tree.

autonomous.title: Autonomous mode
autonomous.description: Only for a dedicated machine: tell the agent not to ask for confirmation before ordinary desktop actions.

server_binary.title: Server binary path
server_binary.description: Path to computer-use-linux. Leave empty to search the install locations and PATH.
